_comment: Head coaches CFBD has no record of (or gets wrong), applied on top of CFBD by scripts/build_coaches_data.py. Every entry cites its source and the name exactly as that source spells it (source_name). coach is the label shown in the dropdown; it differs from source_name only to match CFBD's spelling of the same coach in neighbouring seasons (so one coach is one option), to join co-coaches into one label, or to store a season with no head coach as "No coach". A season-level entry replaces CFBD for that school-season; an entry with game_id applies to that one game only. Seasons no source covers are left missing on purpose.
